title: "I am in detention. The movement is not."
situation: Student leader detained with 200+ marchers; earlier she renamed the march point: Dilli Haat is "Jantar Mantar today". Another leader tells supporters to make wherever police stop them their Jantar Mantar.

lines.text: I am in detention. The movement is not.
lines.speaker: Neha Bora

lines.text: Wherever the Delhi Police try to stop you, make it your Jantar Mantar.
lines.speaker: Ajinkya Shinde (CJP)

buildThis.situation: When barricades seal the main site, Mira can declare "yahi Jantar Mantar hai" wherever the crew is sitting, and the hotspot moves there.
